A competitor capitalized on the opportunity for market share, launching a rival drone delivery service. The endeavour won over investors by demonstrating the convenience and advantages of drone technology. The WANT shopping website has completed testing on the drone delivery system. Shoppers are asked to install a drone delivery terminal at home. Going forward, all goods ordered online will be delivered by drone from a central distribution centre. Delivery time is expected to be in the range of several minutes. When approaching the delivery point, drones will use sound and light cues to signal arrival. The drone will then automatically access the at-home delivery terminal and return to the distribution centre. No actions are required on the part of the shopper.

This technology is likely to solve the delivery dilemma. Plenty of residents have pre-ordered the terminal installation service, it’s likely to be a standard for every family in the city in the near future. (To find out more, check out indie puzzle game on Steam.)

In modern society, it is increasingly common for citizens to shun those outside of their social circles. Here is the latest update on the death of Defoss CEO Kapil Modi, which has been widely discussed online. This morning, reporters learned from J.N. LLP that Kapil Modi's former wife Lisa Snyder has hired the firm to handle all legal matters related to Kapil Modi's suicide. Ever since October 7th on which day her former husband revealed his marriage experience on a social platform and then committed suicide, a lot of attention has been attracted. She was also harassed by many internet users. Therefore, a legal team was entrusted to issue a legal statement requesting people to stop the cyber violence. This is the full text of the statement:
J.N. LLP
Public statement issued by Miss Lisa Snyder through by J.N. LLP with regard to her divorce

First of all, we are deeply saddened by the passing of Mr. Kapil Modi and express our sympathy to his family. However, recently there have been all kinds of insults and defamation made online against Ms. Snyder. These behaviors severely affected Ms. Snyder's physical and mental health. Thus, on behalf of Ms. Snyder, we would like to make the following clarification: 1) Mr. Modi committed domestic violence against Miss Snyder multiple times during their marriage. The most serious instance occurred on August 9, 2021, which caused physical injuries. As a result, Ms. Snyder proposed divorce immediately afterwards. 2) Ms. Snyder and Mr. Modi came to an agreement on the divorce arrangement on October 2, 2021, which entailed Mr. Modi paying 10 million euros along with a villa to Ms. Snyder as alimony. 3) During the negotiation of the divorce arrangement, the communication between them was smooth with no irrational behavior. Mr. Modi's mood was quite stable. 4) Miss Snyder had another short marriage before Mr. Modi. Her former husband was Robert Cohen, and this fact was known to Mr. Modi before their marriage. There was no concealment. Based on all of the above, we want to issue the following statement: 1) To those who posted false information related to the above on the internet, please remove these contents immediately. 2) To those who are continuing their acts of infringement, we reserve the right to pursue legal action to the fullest extent.

Today, some netizens claimed that Kapil Modi, CEO of Defoss, had committed suicide by jumping off the company building. The reason behind the suicide was allegedly related to his former wife. Reporters later confirmed Kapil Modi's suicide with the police. His family reported the case, and the police is currently investigating.

This incident has attracted netizens' attention, and the suicide note has also been forward many times. It is reported that Modi and his ex-wife Lisa Snyder knew each other through the Internet dating website Imeet. Modi has spent millions of euro on Lisa before getting married, but the ex-wife concealed her marriage history. After the marriage, Lisa threatened Modi with a divorce based on "his tax evasion and company irregularities", and continued to harass Modi for 10 million euros compensation.
As of right now, Defoss is still operating normally, and Lisa Snyder has not issued any statement.

Today, some people posted that Kapil Modi, CEO of Defoss, committed suicide by jumping off the building where the company is located on the internet. The reason of suicide is suspected to be related to his ex-wife. The reporter learned from the police that the deceased did indeed commit suicide by jumping off the building. His family reported the case and the police are currently investigating.

This has caused an uproar in the online world. It is reported that Modi and his former wife Lisa Snyder met through the dating site Imeet. After getting married, Lisa said she had experienced domestic violence from Modi and therefore demanded 10 million euros as compensation. Modi suffered a major blow as a result. The company was also affected.
Defoss's service currently has 70 million users and greatly influenced Allivia, but Defoss has not issued any statement until now.

On October 13, researchers at cyber security firm Hacken claimed to have recently found a publicly accessible database containing 150 GB of private data. After careful review, it is believed the database belongs to Titan Matrix and contains sensitive information such as real legal names, dates of birth, home addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, occupations, Hitalk and Toothbook account details, etc.. Hacken stated that it is unclear how long the database has been made public on the internet, how many people have been affected, whether anyone has accessed the leaked server or if people affected have been notified of the incident. This is the worst data breach since 2019.

Last year, Titan Matrix collaborated with Smith Food Products, the nation's largest pork processing company, to build a special mathematical model by analyzing 50 million pieces of data. The data was also compared with swine flu data from the National Ministry of Agriculture in the past 10 years. The model has successfully predicted the spread of swine flu in winter, even identifying specific regions and cities. The two companies will conduct more in-depth collaboration to reduce the outbreak of diseases and monitor the entire life-cycle of pigs.

On the 10th a new round of ransomware attack happened around the world. Government agencies, central banks, energy and communication systems in many countries were attacked. Servers of the world's largest oil companies were also hacked by the virus, and the backup production management system had to be activated. The official websites were hijacked as well. The World Bank issued a warning that the unknown ransomware was attacking the credit system of financial institutions in many countries and that some bank servers had already been hacked. The global shipping giant Manukki Shipping Group and the world's largest communication service company WEP Group were among the victims. Many network security service companies said that the ransomware was a variation of the known virus Paya, which encrypted computer files and forced victims to pay ransom to unlock the encrypted files. According to the latest report, bank accounts related to the ransomware have been seized, and authorities advise victims not to pay any ransom.

We are very glad you decided to try the trailer of . Before start, please let us give some explanations about the demo and the game. We wish it can help you understand this game better.
Nowadays, the Internet and people's daily life are inextricably linked. The speed of information transmit dramatically increases, which makes a negative incident known by the entire Internet rapidly.

In the process, crimes will be exposed and punished, which makes society happy; but some times, people are suffering malicious cursing and humiliation from keyboard warriors. When these cyber-violences continue to escalate, the results of cyber-violences usually exceed the incident itself. Even more, the victim may be overwhelmed under stress and choose to end their precious life.

Therefore, we decided to develop a game related to the theme of "Hacker", " " and "Privacy Data Breaches", allowing players to be a hacker and apply social engineering technique on the target person, find out their privacy and secrets. Manipulate the destiny of the target person above him/her like a "god" and witness their endings. We wish through this process, players could consider the incident in-depth and make their judgments. Maybe one day, players experience similar incidents in reality. Please make the decision with kindness and humanity.

The name of the game is called " " for now, because we feel that such a word not only summarize the theme of the game but also leave a space that players can imagine. Of course, if there is a better or more appropriate name, we will consider replacing it.

The game mainly talks about the protagonist - a pretty famous hacker. (described below in the first person) I was employed by a big data company to help them improve their netizen information in the database. But when I joined them, I feel the things did not as simple as the company said. The company seemed to be using me to achieve certain purposes.

On October 7, NIC was attacked by an unidentified hacker. It’s reported that the main screens of all the computers have been changed to a clown photo, and the security staff found that the hacker directly logged into the backend of the system using the admin password. Until now, NIC has not found any records of data being deleted or tampered with, nor received any blackmail or threats. The specific purpose of the hacker remains unknown, but it appears to be some kind of provocative act. NIC is an important government agency where information of all government departments is kept. The National Security Center has already been involved in the investigation, and the current status is unknown.

There is new update on the controversial suicide incident of Defoss's CEO from a while back. New evidence has emerged, including the chat history of Modi’s ex-wife Lisa and her lawyer. She admitted to being married multiple times in order to defraud money, and her marriage to Modi was no exception. The so-called domestic violence was also found to be a lie. Public opinion has now switched from supporting Lisa to rebuking her. The exact identity of the informant is unclear, while Lisa and her team of lawyers have yet to respond.

After evidence of Lisa cheating emerged, other members of her team were also exposed. It is reported that Lisa’s team has conducted a number of fraudulent marriage schemes, from finding and contacting targets to extorting them for money. There was clear division of labor as each member played different roles. The team's chat record showed that they had threatened Modi several times, eventually forcing him to commit suicide. Modi's sister already reported the case to the police, who have started an investigation. The current status is unknown.

Recently, it was reported that the well known matchmaking website Imeet had quietly shut down its VIP service. The VIP payment channels on the website are now all closed, and the related links have also expired. An insider revealed that Imeet’s VIP service had allegedly carried out questionable operations such as modifying member information and was forced to be shut down after being reported. Reporters have contacted the website's customer service, who claimed the closure of the VIP service was due to brand upgrade. It is unknown when the service will be available again. However, the existing VIP customers will remain unaffected and can continue to enjoy exclusive services.

Yesterday, Titan announced that it had successfully acquired Defoss. After the completion of this acquisition, Defoss will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Titan. Daniel Kos the original CTO of Defoss will now serve as the director of public relations at Titan. Defoss was caught in a storm after the suicide incident of its founder, and the acquisition by Titan is viewed by many as an act of rescue.

Campus Introduction

was established in the city of Gauti in 1999 with a construction land area of over 70,000 square meters. The admission, graduation and competition results in the past three years have remained in the top three in Gauti. It is regarded as one of the best high schools in the city. The school ranks among the top in the country in terms of teaching performance, the faculty, and technology.
was co-founded by Ms. Mackie Cousy and her husband Mr. Salen Will.

Ms. Cousy is a renowned entrepreneur in Gauti and the chairman of car company Cousy. Over the years, she has demonstrated her passion for public welfare, focusing on the healthy growth of children. She has donated large amount of money and school supplies to orphans on numerous occasions. She was appointed to the position of Public Welfare Ambassador of Gauti in 2020. Ms. Cousy founded with her husband in 1999. A strong believer in "learning through joy and growing up healthily", Bolton's mission is to help students receive a good education. Ms. Cousy has always stressed the importance of mental health of each individual child while also focusing on academic performance, so as to nurture a better future for them.
AI painting robot

A highly intelligent AI robot that can replicate human creativity in painting. Upon receiving a verbal command, it will draw flowers, birds, fishes, insects, mountains and lakes, creating artistic value.
Volcanic eruption simulation
Recreating a volcanic eruption. This super cool simulation experiment allows you to feel as if you’re at the site of a real volcanic eruption! It will pump up the adrenaline of thrill seekers!
Maglev table lamp
Sound-controlled desk lamp made by the principle of magnetic suspension. Beautiful and practical, no need to be afraid of the dark anymore!
Campus mascot - eagle wood carving!
The campus mascot that took a lot of time and efforts to make - the eagle carving, I hope to have the support of everyone!
Micro seabed landscape
It took 1 week to produce the micro seabed landscape. The attention to details and recreation process make you feel like you are at the bottom of the sea!

The case of the missing boy, Austin, has received a lot of attention, and new findings about the case have just been released. This morning around 8 am, police found his car at Lake Murray. Unfortunately, there were no signs of Austin. However, a considerable amount of blood and burn marks were found in the trunk. The blood has been identified as belonging to Austin. As for evidence of Austin being alive, the police spokesperson was unable to give a conclusive answer. Up till today, Austin's family has not received any indications of blackmail, kidnapping, or extortion. The causes of Austin's disappearance remain under investigation. Police have now cordoned off the area and have initiated a blanket search. Police are asking anyone with further information about the incident to come forward as soon as possible.

originalData.data: when a girl named Ann accidentally started a fire burning herself in the process

segment.source: Earlier this month, an accident occurred at a celebration, . The fire was quickly put out. Nobody other than the mentioned girl was injured. Immediately after the incident, she was rushed to a hospital.

After half a month of treatment, the girl is no longer at risk. principal Mackie Cousy apologized to the girl and her family for the incident promising increased safety measures on campus afterward. The girl's family has decided not to seek compensation from the school.

On October 29, in the early morning hours, there was a tragic traffic accident on Mullin Road. A car suddenly careened into the guardrail and ran off the road on the way down. At the time of the accident, there were two people were in the car. The driver, a male, died at the scene, and the other, a female currently in a coma, was thrown from the car. She has been transported to a nearby hospital. The deceased man has been identified as Jon Thompson, a hotel manager, and the woman is named Sarah Smith. Detailed identities and the exact cause of the accident are still under investigation.

Sarah Smith, the woman involved in the Mullin Road accident, recovered early yesterday from a coma. After a day of recuperation, she's now stable. She has since revealed to the police the cause of the accident. A month prior, after arriving in Gauti she stayed at Jon's hotel, where she was secretly filmed and later threatened by the hotel manager. On the day of the incident, Sarah was coerced to accompany the man to Mullin Road. On the way down the hill, she decided to fight back and grabbed the steering wheel, causing the vehicle to run off the road out of control. According to the police investigation, Jon had also coerced another woman named Elsie, and it was Elsie who proposed the idea to go to Mullin Road. She planned to take revenge on Jon at Mullin Road. However, she was later persuaded by friends not to go through with it, which enraged Jon. In Elsie's stead, Jon violently forced Sarah to go, which ultimately led to this incident. While the police have been investigating a series of crimes related to Jon Thompson, Sarah's testimony has already seemed to confirm some of the suspicions.

A few days ago, the police received an anonymous tip that someone was using video blackmail to compel women and commit crimes. After an investigation, those behind this mysterious business chain were revealed. The ringleader was a college student named Mason Toney, who, as president of the school drama club, used the auditions to coax girls into making indecent videos. Later he used these videos to blackmail them to commit crimes on his behalf. In addition to that, he also collaborated with more than 20 hotels in Gauti, where he installed cameras to make secret recordings from which he would choose his new targets. And Jon Thompson, who died the other day on Mullin Road, was one of the hotel directors who colluded with Mason. Jon, likewise, used videos to blackmail women. They uploaded the aforementioned videos to their website and formed group chats in Hitalk to make money. As of now, around 20,000 people have been registered on the site and about ‎10 million Euros have changed hands. It is reported that all hotels involved in the extortion ring have been shut down, and the website has ceased operations. The Hitalk group has been disbanded, and all the people in charge have been arrested. The case is still in hearings.

Ava and Hannah have not had the best of luck in the workplace. They were constantly suppressed by their boss Mia and never received any promotion. In retaliation, the two conspired and murdered Mia. In order to prevent the police from discovering their crime, the two came up with a seamless lie using “spatial reconstruction”, which entailed creating a fictional timeline on the day of the incident. They also buried the body in the mountain. However, though the mills of God grind slowly, yet they grind exceeding small. Years later, Mia’s body was found, and the case was re-opened. In the end, notwithstanding that Ava and Hannah had already become senior executives, they were arrested by the police...

Three summers ago, four girls emerged from a talent show with their innocent image and became the talk of the town that summer. The group was Young Girl.

The four girls are the beauty Helen Garcia , the singer Barbie Saya , the rapper Myrtie Assis and the dancer Susan Mook.At that time, people generally believed that they would be the future superstars of the girl group industry, and were very optimistic about their development. However, the four suddenly announced the group's disbandment and went their own way just as the team was in its prime. It was said that the reason for the disbandment was an internal conflict within the team. Since then, their paths have never crossed again.

A month ago, Myrtie and Susan were photographed at a company cocktail party where they were seen acting affectionately with top executives. They were asked to "get out of the entertainment industry" by their fans and some netizens, as their image was clearly not in line with their innocent persona. The two faded from public view after the incident. In the same year, Helen Garcia was found dead in her home. According to her friends, she had been suffering from severe depression for a long time and needed to rely on medication. Although she had always appeared cheerful to the public, she suffered a lot of pain behind the scenes.
Barbie Saya, who is still active in the entertainment industry, has become a popular singer and dancer, and the Young Girl team has become a memory of that summer.

Reporter: Ashley Clayson

After a long period of hard work, we are now making excellent progress in our research work in the field of artificial intelligence, which is expected to put the company ahead of the industry in the field of communication services and big data processing by 10 years.
At the same time, I have a whole new way of thinking in terms of further enhancing artificial intelligence and machine judgment. Through the research of psychology, a brand new discovery was made in the field of human brain, time perception and neurology. Consciousness is a connection that breaks through the programmed settings. In short, the brain is in fact an algorithm, and understanding this algorithm will allow it to be replicated. At the same time, since this algorithm is equivalent to consciousness, then consciousness should also be replicable and transferable.
According to this theory we only need to complete the following steps to transfer consciousness to an AI: * Creation of artificial intelligence with the same consciousness algorithms as the test subjects * Using a method to extract and copy the memory of test subjects to an artificial intelligence * Integration of the consciousness of the subject with that of the AI
We could then have an AI with the ability to translate computer language more effectively, and more in tune with human judgment and comprehension, with the freedom to access a near-infinite amount of data. Perhaps this is more than AI, a transcendence of the biological nature of the human body, a superhuman, a semblance of a future human being, even a form of immortality, a glorious discovery.
Of course this is just a theory, but I can turn it into reality and have already made progress on an AI that has a consciousness algorithm, which has the same self-awareness as humans. I hope the company will provide more financial support to help complete this unprecedented project. I believe this project can bring dramatic changes to the company and even the entire society and that it will lead the human race to a new evolution!
Dr. Tom Blanco

Although the company rejected the proposal for a self-aware artificial intelligence, earlier in a series of experiments, I believe I have found the "key" and am only one step away from success. Artificial intelligence evolves at a rate that obeys Moore's Law - doubling performance every 18 months, while the rate of human evolution is 20 years per generation. If my theoretical experiment in artificial intelligence succeeds, it will be a discovery big enough to shake the entire academic world, no, it will be an evolution. Nothing will stop me.
The new experiment sample (experiment no. 73511178) passed the Turing test perfectly and ended up having high level of perception, but there were problems with the key point of self-awareness. The experiment sample wouldn't doubt its own existence. It was after all still a machine.
Exactly what went wrong is not yet known for certain. Perhaps the experiment was headed in the wrong direction, but fortunately I had a backup plan ready.
The volunteer was involved in another experimental project (experiment no. -003), in which I simulated the conscious behavior of his brain in the hope that this would create a new self-aware artificial intelligence.
Experiment log
Security level: Lv4

Research on how to further optimize the judgment and intelligence levels of the Expert System (experiment no. 63511234) has almost come to a standstill. At the request of Dr. Tom Blanco, the whole project team is now thinking about how to implement his bold idea, but it is said that the top management of the company does not approve of his research either. Yet his nearly insane attitude is something that no one in the project team can defy.
Maybe what he said about self-aware AI really does work, and it would certainly be a major discovery that could change human history, but is this idea really ethical? No one else seems to care about this moral dilemma.
Fortunately, my colleague Vincent and I shared the same thoughts, which strengthened my resolve to continue my research on the Expert System.

The Modi incident went very well, and we now know about all the events leading up to it, thanks to his flawless performance in analyzing and processing the most valuable information from the internet, and in piecing the information together using various social work techniques to obtain further key information about the target. He was able to use this key information to carry out inference and to finally arrive at an answer.
And branching outward from the event itself to get more inside information, some of which I would collaborate with other departments to evaluate strategically, may result in other hidden benefits to the company.
Now that we have the bulk of the intelligence on Defoss fully in hand, our colleagues in the Department of Asset Investment can get started. I believe we will take our current big data business to the next level after we get Defoss.
With regard to his abilities, which are currently far more powerful than we can imagine, it is recommended that the test be expanded and more difficult tasks be assigned to him.
End of report.

Dr. Tom Blanco is directly responsible for this incident. This issue was triggered when he gave away the company's core secrets with no regard for the company's interests, I suggest that the top management of the company consider reprimanding him further and review all the projects he was responsible for to prevent any further data leakage.
During the investigation, the system successfully detected the hack set up by the culprit to prevent us from tracking him down. The system was able to identify the mastermind behind it by analyzing hierarchical relationships, and successfully hacked into his server to destroy the missing data to save the company's losses. This is exactly the kind of performance that I mentioned before, and it is certain to have a positive impact on the company's next business development.
The mysterious man behind this calls himself "", and we're still unable to find anything about him in our database. His target this time was our important experimental data, thus we must increase security. I suggest conducting an in-depth investigation into this person to prevent the recurrence of similar incidents in the future.
Report concluded.
Ashley Clayson

I, Dr. Tom Blanco, am willing to accept any reprimands, but I want to mention that I didn't reveal any classified information about the company's current business. The data revealed was experimental and incomplete, and even if someone got it, they'd be unable to reach any realistic results. Without me, the data can not be unencrypted into something meaningful, so having the data leave the company shouldn't be considered such a serious betrayal, as some people advocate.
Additionally, I would like to once again plead with the company executives to re-evaluate the project Ashley Clayson is currently working on. Her social experimentation is an affront to humanity. Also, think about what can we gain from such a project. The company should focus on its existing business, not on one "person" gaining some special ability to tell the company what to do. So, stop this. You might be thinking that I'm just getting back at them because they found out about my slip-up. Yes, I admit it's part of my intention, but I'm thinking more for you. Their system could hack me today, maybe it will hack all of you tomorrow. You will lose your secrets and become exposed. It won't be long before you will be gawked at and judged by everyone!
This plan was wrong from the start, you all have been manipulated by Ashley Clayson. Stopping it right now will create the best outcome for the company.
Dr. Tom Blanco

After several rounds of experiments, we tried to enhance the neural network to increase the speed of processing information. A neural network is an algorithmic mathematical model of distributed parallel information processing that mimics the behavioral characteristics of animal neural networks. This network relies on the complexity of the system to process information by adjusting the interconnections between a large number of internal nodes.
A number of single neurons are linked together so that the output of one neuron can be the input of another neuron. But an interesting feature found in the multi-layer intertwined self-coding process is that the Expert System also generates a "subjective idea" while providing an answer. The "subjective idea" is completely random, and I have no control over its specific content, but it is logically related to the question.
The power of imagination is probably a seed left behind by God for mankind. Imagining things that do not exist and expressing them. Human beings analyze each other's behaviors by measuring the behaviors against their own standard and "subjectively analyzing" them in order to make predictions about each other, thus generating feelings. This is a natural born ability of human beings and the basis of human emotions, which is the expression of human nature.
Yet the experiment sample is learning this phenomenon, which is amazing.

Dr. Lucrezia Borgia of the Department of Artificial Intelligence Experiments died yesterday in a traffic accident after work. All the information of the experimental project she conducted at the company before her death has been sealed off and, at the recommendation of the person in charge, confidentiality is at the highest level (LV3). All of her remaining personal belongings were returned to her family by the Administration Department.
The death of Dr. Lucrezia Borgia is a great loss to the company, and a small memorial service will be held for her, to be attended by colleagues from several departments. Her previous projects will be taken over by Dr. Tom Blanco.

The experiment sample (experiment no. 63511234) was rebooted after being unsealed, and its performance in the field of big data processing and network information processing is very good. The results from combining with the Expert System is almost comparable to that of top hackers. But what interests me most is the "humanity" mentioned by Lucrezia. If my theory is correct, the unexpected appearance of this "humanity" in her experiment may be the closest thing to "self-awareness". But before that she had no intention of including it in my project, much less sharing her findings.
Now it's just a matter of reverse engineering and understanding the algorithms involved and what produced this little accident so that it can be fused with my experiment sample to create a truly self-aware AI. I didn't realize Lucrezia had encrypted part of it. It seems the woman had left us a little too soon.
However, it should be possible to simulate the "humanity" to be expressed by the experiment sample with only what is available now.
This experiment sample (experiment no. 63511234) will be treated as a failed sample because part of the content cannot be deciphered. Result: permanently sealed after clearing all the data stored in memory.

Yesterday, former member of Young Girls, Barbie Saya, made an appearance on the variety show "The New Music King". This is the first variety show Barbie Saya has participated in since her former group disbanded. The news drew many of Barbie Saya's fans to the filming site.

However, this morning, an anonymously authored article came out on the internet suggesting that Barbie Saya is a monumental diva. The recording was scheduled for 10 a.m., but Barbie Saya didn't arrive until 12 a.m. with eight assistants, citing that it was too early to get up. She refused to eat the lunch box provided by the production team and requested to book a 5-star restaurant. She also asked her assistant to buy hand-ground coffee from MoonBucks 5km away. All of these circumstances caused the show to delay filming to 3pm. "

However, Barbie Saya's diva-like behavior did not end there. The article also states, "Right after 6:00 p.m., Barbie Saya stopped the recording and asked for an increase in payment on the spot, saying that it was overtime and also she requested they schedule her dinner immediately. In order to keep the show on air, the production team had to agree to these demands, and the recording, which was scheduled to end at 4:00 p.m., was finally completed at 11:00 p.m. "

After the articles publication, it drew considerable attention from netizens, with many Barbie Saya fans stating that it was the production team's plan to make hype. However, according to Barbie Saya fans who were there at the time, the recording did end at 11:00 that day and Barbie Saya, who was scheduled to sing 3 songs, ended up singing only 1 song.

Many netizens felt the provided information brought light to Barbie Saya's worrying lack of professionalism, whether it's raising her fees on the spot or being a prima donna, it's clearly not an attitude that any star should have.

After he dropped out of high school, he tried many different jobs. He eventually became a live streamer after receiving encouragement from friends. Michael Holdom - a pioneer in hypnotism and its application
Michael Holdom is a professor in the Department of Psychology at and studies the role of hypnotism in the treatment of patients with post-traumatic stress disorder.

Michael Holdom is an expert in subconsciousness and hypnotism research. During the hypnotism process, he would try to minimize a patient's defense by providing support and encouragement. Throughout the hypnotism treatment, he would provide constructive advice to alleviate a patient's anxiety and negativity. Metaphor and indirect guidance are used to create a comfortable environment for the patients so that they can spontaneously understand their internal potential which they might not be aware of before. Michael Holdom has always believed that psychological problems can only be solved "by helping patients open up".

The treatment he developed has been widely applied and has received high recognition for contributing to treatment of psychological traumas. He is considered the most favorable candidate to become the next president of the Psychology and Hypnotism Society.
Professor Michael Holdom railed against the latest soundwave therapy
Paul Paxson is a professor in the Department of Psychology at . His main research area is the correlation between hypnotic sensitivity and ambient soundwaves.

Professor Paul Paxson has made a major breakthrough in his research. He claimed to have developed a way to use soundwaves to hypnotize patients and carry out psychotherapy. He called it "soundwave therapy".

Professor Michael Holdom, also a professor of psychology at , objected. He argued that Paxson's research was not as "useful" as it was claimed because he found out that Paxson had not maintained professional integrity during his experiments. Paxson used soundwaves to hypnotize and influence his subjects without informing them. Although Paxson later apologized to the subjects and was forgiven, his action still went against the original purpose of hypnotism.

Michael believes that hypnotism should be conducted with the consent and knowledge of the subject. Any research via involuntary hypnotism should be banned. Paxson responded by claiming that Professor Holdom had always been his academic mentor and that he aspires for Michael's approval.Although his research was unfortunately disapproved by Professor Holdom, Paxson insisted that his research was of cross-generation significance. A "minor mistake" in the experiment will not shake his belief in continuing with his research.
Professor Paul Paxson who proposed soundwave therapy was fired.
Ever since Professor Paul Paxson introduced soundwave therapy, many have raised their concerns about its future development.

Mainstream academics such as Michael Holdom believe that Paul's work has gone against the purpose of hypnotism. This kind of involuntary hypnotism research should be banned. Paul's research is going to open a Pandora's box with unimaginable consequences.
The University of Alpha had warned Professor Paxson, but he insisted on continuing his research. Alpha university fired Paxson for ethical reasons.

Character introduction
Leon Dawson

Leon Dawson is the leading male character in the 2017 sci-fi movie Tikanic. It was played by Jack. In the movie, Leon is humorous, carefree, affectionate and willing to sacrifice himself for his loved one.
Leon Dawson is one of the most famous and classic characters in film history. Together with Kate from Tikanic, they are the most famous film couple in history.
Plot summary

On April 10th, 2212, the inter-planetary spacecraft Tikanic, a miracle of human engineering, set off on its maiden voyage from Earth to Mars. Kate, who comes from a royal family, stays in first class cabinet with her mom and her fiancé; while Leon, a carefree young singer, wins his ticket to economy class in a singing contest. Kate grows tired of the hypocrisy of royal life and doesn't want to marry Zane. She decides to escape from the spacecraft and let herself drift in the universe until she dies. But she is saved by Leon. Very soon, the beautiful Kate and the handsome Leon fall in love. Leon invites Kate to different parties in the economy class. He also writes songs for her, and their love grows everyday. On May 10th, 2212, the "indestructible" Tikanic collides with a meteoroid stream and is completely destroyed. Leon and his new love are faced with a life-and-death situation.

Why did the ZMP algorithm become the mainstream balance algorithm for biped robots?
I'm planning to participate in next year's robot competition. I'm still in the preparation stage, so may I ask why the ZMP algorithm has become so popular?
R.B.Doogan

At the very beginning, the balance control strategy for biped robot is "static walking". The special thing about this strategy is that the projection of the center of gravity is always on the polygon support area while the robot's walking. The advantage of this control strategy is that the robot can stop walking without falling over, but at the cost of being very slow. Later, another walking balance strategy called "dynamic walking" was developed. In dynamic walking, the robot's movement speed is increased to no more than 1 second per step. But the disadvantage is that the robot can't stop immediately while in motion, which makes the robot unstable during the process of state transition. Zero Moment Point (ZMP) was introduced to deal with the impact of habits. The advantage of introducing ZMP is that the robot will never fall if it is restricted to just the support area. The above is a quick overview of the history. Hope it helps.

However, Dora and Cody were caught by and bombs were then strapped to their bodies.

Using an EMP attack, we brought down 's server and successfully deleted .

Position Adjustment Memo

It is with great sadness that we announce the tragic loss of Professor Lucrezia Borgia. She died in a car accident on February 11, 2021. To continue the work of Professor Lucrezia Borgia, Professor Tom Blanco will be taking over Professor Borgia's projects, effective immediately.
New Collaboration Announcement

We are pleased to announce that Titan Matrix has been invited to work with the soon-to-be established Security Investigation Department (CSID) of the Allivia police department to develop an intelligent system in cyber security. This will be the first intelligent system in the era of big data to analyze the characteristics and nature of potential crime using AI in order to protect public safety. Titan promises to keep all data confidential. It will only be used by the CSID.
The breakthrough in ‘Brain’ project

During the past three years, Titan has conducted in-depth research through Project "Brain". Through this project, microchips will be implanted into human brains to increase their computing power and to heal previously permanent brain damage. As a test project to increase the power of human brains, Project "Brain" has been controversial from the beginning. Today we have made some breakthroughs in combining human brains with microchips and have improved the conditions of those who suffer from brain damage. This is proof that the project is not only feasible but also necessary.
Expanding Investment Strategy

Titan Matrix will officially expand its investment area in the coming three years through a new round of investments in the multimedia and digital PR sectors. The target companies will each go through three rounds of negotiation. The target list is as follows: 1. 2.Aluba 3.Hugo Weekly

Today society has already entered a new age of connected smart devices. As an expert in information technology, Titan Matrix has invested in building a Four-Dimensional Big Data platform. Through integrating various big data engines, massive amount of data will be collected, processed and converted. The value of data will also be maximized, providing more effective, accurate and convenient analyses and planning for society as well as improving the quality of life.

Project "Brain" is currently the most challenging field at Titan Matrix - microchip implant in human brains. By having Project "Brain" focus on this area, not only could previously permanent brain damage be reversed, but a new way to enhance human intelligence will also be provided. We believe mankind will be able to directly obtain knowledge from these microchips and conserve energy, truly sharing knowledge and enhancing the overall level of intelligence. Through Project "Brain", we want to explore a new direction for human evolution.
AI - Expert System

Titan Matrix has developed a new AI Expert System. It can possess the same empathy as a human being and is absolutely obedient, which will enable the system to better serve mankind. The Expert System can be integrated with the Four-Dimensional Big Data platform, provide constructive solutions to solve complex problems and serve the public from the viewpoint of a human being. The system is currently still in closed beta testing.

Since its establishment, Titan has been deeply engaged in the field of big data and artificial intelligence. We aim to facilitate life and explore the future with technology. We are confident that we will lead the new wave of revolutonary technology coming soon.

Professor Borgia, I'm surprised you found such a perfect subject!
Benjamin Engel stood out of 120,000 volunteers. He is simply God's greatest work.
High IQ, preternatural memory, amazing logical and calculation skills, plus extreme emotional stability and strong endurance... I bet there is no better data than him in the world!
How do you know all this?!
I've worked at Titan Labs for ten years. Getting a volunteer report is easy for me.
We may seem completely different, but this difference might be what makes our collaboration sparkle.
Professor Borgia, I'd like you to work with me. What do you think?
It doesn't sound like a good idea, and it's not necessary.
Don't be too hasty. It's unwise to reject me so quickly.
Ha.
Professor Blanco, if I remember correctly, you plagiarized a student's research results three months ago and smeared him, blacklisting him forever in the scientific community.
So you don't have to save face in front of me.
I will never share my research subjects and experimental data with the scum of the scientific community.
You will pay for your words!
You bitch! Death was probably a relief for your husband and son!
You are just surprisingly stupid, treating an experimental subject like your own son. How ridiculous!!!
Do you think he will be grateful to you?
Benjamin is just a monkey waiting to be experimented on! The only thing of value is his brain!
You'll regret your decision. The first thing I'm gonna destroy is his brain!
You touch him, and I promise you will disappear from this world.
You are ridiculous.
He is a genius, but the price of being a genius is chronic insomnia, anorexia, and depression! There's no way he'll live past the age of 30!
Your experiment is doomed to failure, Lucrezia.
You're such a miserable old woman!
I told you you'd pay for it, didn't I? It's just this time it's with your life!
Bye, old woman. You'll soon be deleted.
Hello, Professor Borgia.
I'm Aogesi Will. I'm a police officer with CSID and I had the pleasure of participating in your Project "Brain" conference last month.
I took the liberty of coming to you because I was hoping that you would allow my sister to volunteer for the Project "Brain".
The application I submitted was rejected because... she is in a vegetative state.
I'm sorry. Although your sister's vitals are good, patients with Alzheimer's disease are really not suitable as volunteers.
But didn't you say that once Project "Brain" succeeds, there will be hope for patients with Alzheimer's disease?
Is that just a bluff?
I understand how you feel, but your sister is really not a qualified candidate.
If you don't want any harm to come to her.
Okay... I hope your experiment will be successful. Please let me know if and when the time comes.
Alright.
I am glad that you agreed to be a volunteer for the Expert System, Benjamin.
Professor Borgia, if I successfully help develop the Expert System, can you really use Project "Brain" technology to cure me?
I've had insomnia for years. The overload of information processing non-stop in my brain is very painful.
Yes, poor kid. Did you take the medication lately?
Yes, I have been following the instructions.
But I don't see any improvement yet.
Don't worry, give it a few more days and maybe it will work.
Okay, I hope so.
Sister Maria needs me back for a while. The weeds are growing especially fast in the convent since it's spring.
She and Dr. Kevin can't keep up with it.
Kevin always knows how to slack off!
Take your trip, but don't tire yourself out. The medical consensus is the day after tomorrow.

I love it. It's going to be my new buddy!

Wow, that's a cool name!

It's killing me.
I know, poor kid. Hold on a little longer.
It will get better.
yep.

I'm coming back. Hang in there!
I'm dying.
I'm almost there!!!

Did Simon come to you before he died?

Shall I compare thee to a summer’s day? Thou art more lovely and more temperate. Rough winds do shake the darling buds of May, And summer’s lease hath all too short a date; Sometime too hot the eye of heaven shines, And often is his gold complexion dimmed, And every fair from fair sometime declines, By chance or nature’s changing course untrimmed; But thy eternal summer shall not fade, Nor lose possession of that fair thou owest, Nor shall Death brag thou wanderest in his shade, When in eternal lines to time thou growest: So long as men can breathe, or eyes can see, So long lives this, and this gives life to thee. — Shakespeare, Sonnet 18

Not interested.

I don't need a girlfriend and I don't want to get married.
Work is my only passion and I love making money. Maybe I'll die single.
You're not in love with that old woman, are you, Lucrezia?

Dang it. You just ruined my day!

Please control yourself, especially if you're cheating with a student.
I have to clean up your mess every time.
Girls are shameless nowadays. They even don't mind posting this kind of thing on the Internet!
By the way,
Has Modi agreed to the takeover yet?
Hmm, he's gonna be dead soon.
Come out and celebrate!
Hahahaha, what a great day!
That old woman, Lucrezia, is finally gone!
Everything is mine now!
You mean the female professor?
How did she die?
Thanks to the help of her dead husband and her right-hand man, Vincent!
Otherwise I would have had to fight her for a while!
Hurry up. I can't wait to celebrate!
Buddy, open a Porn X VIP account for me.

I've got some of their favorite college students for the "big bosses"!
The girls from the drama club were fighting to come. The ones selected are all stunning!
Sounds awesome!
I'll create a group and send the time and location in the group. Clear the chat history once read.
Are you still up?
What's wrong? It's late.
Sorry for bothering you at this hour.
I was going through Lucrezia's and my old transportation tickets today and I found something very strange... It's kinda bizarre.
You arranged all my schedules, right?
What are you getting at?
Lucrezia and I share many similarities, including keeping old tickets.
Today when I was going through Lucrezia's and my old transportation tickets, I found that our schedules during our dating period overlapped perfectly.
What does that tell you?
Um... that you two are destined for each other?!
Haha, didn't you get together because you two always bumped into each other and had very compatible personalities?
You yourself often say that you two are meant for each other.
No!
I really believed that, but today I realized it wasn't the case!
We were put together by "fate", but what is this "fate"!!
You've been working too hard lately, Simon. You need to get some rest.
Speaking of work, there is something that has always haunted me.
During the interview at Titan, several interviewees were better than me in terms of capability and experience, so why was I the one that got the job?
The interviewer liked you? There were probably many factors involved.
Shirley and I were the only ones that got the job.
When I put this all together, I feel a chill down my spine!
You're worn out, Simon. Listen to me, you should get some sleep.
Big data?
I was the best match with Lucrezia, and you wanted to have the orphaned and unattached Lucrezia completely under your control!
Calm down, Simon. This is all in your head.
Your manager sent you on a business trip and I happened to book Lucrezia on the same flight and train.
Do you really think I'd believe such a pale excuse? The rooms we stayed in on business trips and the apartments that the company provided were all next to each other!
This is creepy! Creepy as hell!
But you love her, don't you?
The company can't afford to lose her.
I'm just a pawn for Titan to keep her in check!
There's no turning back for you, Simon.
You shouldn't have come to me today.
Are our chats all being monitored?!
Lucrezia's decision to resign is a big deal.
She is contributing to humanity and we can't stand to lose her.
Yet, you happened to figure something out at this crucial time.
If you don't want anything to happen to Lucrezia and Billy, keep your mouth shut until you get to the office tomorrow.
What you're going to experience is the real power of "fate."
Is there any way to turn things back?
You shouldn't even be thinking about this. It's too late.
You promise to not harm Billy and find a better family for him?
Yes, everything has been arranged.
I don't want any of this! Lily, there must be something you can do!
Simon, there's no going back.
If you weren't so smart, maybe it wouldn't have to end this way.
Just accept reality.
Otherwise Lucrezia will be in danger. You and Billy have to leave.
Disappear forever.
Goodbye, Simon.
Maybe my fate will end like this, too.
What about the volunteer?
Not found yet.
I hope he is never found.
Who the hell is he?
Lucrezia won't talk about it. I heard he was an orphan from a monastery.
Ashley,
Take my advice, never get married.
Hey?
Hey? Pick up the phone!
Pick up the phone!
Dang it, I can never reach you!
Pick up the phone!!!
Why are you still awake in the middle of the night?
Emergency!
You want me to get up to pee?
Let's talk on the phone!!!
It's over.
You got what you wanted.
Don't dare to talk to me now?
So did you come to me to help me or to kill Lucrezia?!
I'm sorry. I really didn't expect that to happen!
It was Simon. He asked me to deliver the message!
I don't know who told him about it, but apparently... we were both used.
What about Benjamin? Is he dead too?
I don't know.
But... he was gonna die sooner or later anyway, wasn't he?
I've seen it all.
Benjamin's medical report
Professor Borgia fooled everyone, didn't she.
She's been using Benjamin since the beginning. Poor Benjamin. He thought they were like family.
I advise you not to speculate on others so maliciously.
You knew it very well, right?
The reason why Professor Borgia kept developing the Expert System was to build an artificial version of her husband and child. She really missed her happy family.
But she never thought that Simon and Billy are still alive.
He is lying in a politician's bed, and the son is sleeping right next door!
As an experimental volunteer, Benjamin's body has suffered tremendous damage!
Now, I want you to shut up and listen to me!
Lucrezia didn't hurt Benjamin! He has an extremely high IQ and EQ, but the cost is that he has serious problems sleeping. Lucrezia was there to treat him!
Cut the crap! Lucrezia wasn't a doctor. Everything she said was just an excuse. She was just trying to get the volunteers' data!
Haven't you noticed that Benjamin's health data got worse after the treatment?
That was just a side effect. You don't know anything. Uninstall Hitalk now and come out with me!
You're an idiot!
The pills Lucrezia gave him weren't sleeping pills but something to make his brain more active!
Benjamin's condition will only get worse. He will gradually lose control of his emotions and experience hallucinations!
After the experiment, his life span will even be shortened. Right now he has at most two years left!
Shirley, calm down!
They've found a copy of Lucrezia's files!

It is with great sadness that we announce the tragic loss of Professor Lucrezia Borgia. She died in a car accident on February 11, 2021. To continue the work of Professor Lucrezia, Professor Tom Blanco will be taking over Professor Borgia's projects, effective immediately.
The 3rd Global Future Intelligence Science Conference will be held in Gauti on July 06, 2017.

The three-day conference aims to facilitate the exchange of cutting-edge AI and bio-development technologies among scientists from various disciplines. There will be discussions of the revolutionary breakthroughs that AI development has brought to modern society, based on the people-oriented principles of technology. There will also be discussions concerning the impact and influence of AI applications on the lives of the general public, and how to ensure citizen data security and privacy while doing scientific research.
Gauti-based Titan Matrix will be sending Professor Tom Blanco and Professor Lucrezia Borgia's scientific teams to the conference.

On February 9, 2016, the husband and the son of Titan Matrix's senior researcher Lucrezia Borgia went hiking in the Ferodin Mountains in the northern part of PHAX. Unfortunately, they encountered a sudden snowstorm and their whereabouts are unknown.
On February 11, 2021, the Allivia police officially issued an arrest warrant for Benjamin Engel for the suspect's involvement in the murder of Professor Lucrezia Borgia of Titan Matrix.

According to the Allivia police, Lucrezia got into a car accident on the C3 Winding Road and fell off a cliff. The vehicle exploded, and Professor Borgia died on spot. Police found a large amount of biological evidence related to Benjamin Engel at the scene. Based on the condition of the vehicle, the police concluded that it was not an accident. Due to Benjamin Engel's unstable mental state, he most likely caused the accident after an argument with Lucrezia Borgia in the car. As such, the police has named Benjamin Engel as the first suspect and are looking for him.

Lucrezia had a tragic life as well. She once had a happy family until her son and husband died in an accident a few years ago. She then devoted herself to research until she met Benjamin Engel. Perhaps out of compassion, Lucrezia treated him as her own and helped him in every way.

However, her appreciation and care did not win his gratitude. Growing up in an orphanage, he has developed a perverse and inferior personality as well as serious mental problems. According to Titan's internal psychological evaluations, Benjamin's mental state was becoming more uncontrollable recently. His painful childhood experiences have made him jealous of others and unable to properly perceive external care. After multiple reminders from the company, Lucrezia finally decided to remove Benjamin from the program in order to protect the safety of the people involved and the company. The day after Lucrezia talked to Benjamin about this matter, the tragic incident happened.

It was assumed that Benjamin Engel had long regarded Professor Lucrezia Borgia as a motherly presence in the research program and had fallen in love with her. And he felt betrayed by her decision to remove him, almost at the level of family betrayal, which evoked his own tragic origin story. His love turned to hate, and led him to murder.
This is a real-life version of the Farmer and the Viper!
Due to the tragic death of Professor Lucrezia Borgia, Titan Matrix announced yesterday that Professor Tom Blanco will take over all of Lucrezia Borgia's work.

On January 1, 2020, Ms. Lana Cliff, a veteran politician, officially announced her participation in the upcoming presidential election. She is the first female candidate ever to run for the office of the president in the country.

Cliff has served in local government for over eight years and has been widely acclaimed. She was given the nickname Iron Rose for her tough attitude in the political arena, but she is not a cold-hearted person. She has devoted all her kindness and care to the commoners.
Her slogan for the presidential election is: Allivia needs a transparent government.

Cliff is sick of the current situation, in which policies are implemented poorly and with almost zero transparency, rendering these policies more of a formality and not executable. She advocates to make government actions more transparent so that the public can better monitor the actual situation and make suggestions accordingly.

Word is that many people strongly agree with Cliff, believing that a lot of Allivia's problems, like corruption, are caused by this. Her opponents, on the other hand, believe that she does not have the qualifications of a politician and is merely a radical idealist.

Tonight Lana Cliff attended and hosted the annual charity party held by the Allivia Association of Healthcare Organizations. Cliff has been in politics for years and has always been earnestly solving people's problems. With the nickname "Iron Rose," she hides her tenderness and delicacy, which helps her see people's suffering.
As for his motive for doing so, we believe he was thinking about getting a divorce.

Professor Tom Blanco has been with Titan Matrix for many years and is a senior expert in the field of artificial intelligence. He is committed to finding solutions to problems related to artificial intelligence and at the same time making breakthroughs in multiple directions.

Local police said tourists were notified to leave the moment the severe weather warning was received. After failed contact with the father and son, the police immediately organized a search and rescue team and launched a retrieval mission.

The impact of the storm will last more than a week. The retrieval mission is seriously hampered and cannot be carried out smoothly. Therefore, Titan has sent technicians to the Ferodin Mountains to cooperate with and aid the police in their search and rescue work.

We haven't been able to reach Professor Lucrezia Borgia, a senior researcher at Titan who is a leading expert in the field of artificial intelligence. Let's hope her family gets through this incident safely.

Can't believe Titan Matrix is the biggest culprit in privacy leakage!

Earlier in the morning, a large number of protesters could be seen gathering in front of the Titan Matrix headquarter. These angry protesters claim that Titan Matrix is the culprit behind privacy leakage.

A banner held by a young woman says: Titan Matrix is the culprit! You took my mother's life! The reporters learned that due to a data breach, her mother became the victim of a telephone fraud. After all of her life's savings was gone, she suffered a heart attack and died. Another man could be seen crying in front of the camera. His daughter's personal information was stolen and used to apply for loans. Unable to repay them, she eventually committed suicide.

More protesters claimed that they would regularly receive marketing phone calls just because they had registered on some websites or searched for certain information. Such breach of personal data has made them very angry. Turns out Titan Matrix, the so-called protector of data privacy, is actually behind everything.

Reporters learned of a report recently released by a network security company called Hacken, which accuses Titan Matrix as the culprit behind all the data leakage in recent years. The report contains all kinds of pictures and information, revealing the illegal means through which Titan Matrix employees obtained and sold citizens' data. The report has led to a major public outcry.
As of the time of this report, Titan Matrix has yet to make any public comments.
Stay tuned for the latest news from Breaking News
Project "Brain"? It's a fraud!

On the official Titan Matrix website, the three major projects Four-Dimensional Big Data, AI and Project "Brain" are listed. Most people have heard of Four-Dimensional Big Data and AI. As for Project "Brain", what exactly is it?

Reliable sources say that due to a bottleneck and lack of progress in AI research, senior management is not happy. Project "Brain" was unveiled by Titan Matrix in an effort to look for a new direction. On the official website, Titan Matrix claims that it is a microchip implant project that can heal brain damage, improve learning capabilities and obtain massive amount of knowledge.

Since the announcement of Project "Brain", Titan Matrix has been recruiting a large number of volunteers and hired several experts in neurology. Public records show that these experts possess years of experience in brain surgery. As such, we have reason to believe that Titan Matrix will carry out their trials by directly implanting microchips into the brains of the volunteers.
Titan Matrix may have a good vision, but is implanting microchips directly into human brains really safe? Who will look after the safety of the volunteers?
A project that goes against morals and ignores the safety of volunteers, such is the true face of Project "Brain"!
Breaking news! Titan Matrix's Project "Brain" could change the future of mankind
According to the official website of Titan Matrix, Project "Brain" is the most challenging research area in the history of the company - microchip implant in human brains.

Titan Matrix plans to implant microchips in human brains and heal previously irreversible brain damage as well as increase the computing power of human brains. According to the released information, Project "Brain" will reverse-engineer the structure of a human brain by simulating it at the neuron level. The function and mechanism of each part of a brain will be confirmed through analyzing all the activities and feedback of a brain. Once the test is successful, Titan Matrix will replace certain functions of a brain with microchips, thus reaching the goal of repairing brain damage and strengthening its computing power.

If this project is successful, not only can mankind heal previously irreversible brain damage, but also directly obtain knowledge through microchips made by Titan Matrix in the future. With the help of cloud computing and cloud storage, mankind will be able to truly share knowledge.

Today Titan Matrix has two research teams with over 100 scientists working on Project "Brain". The academic community has expressed deep interest in the project. While many researchers look forward to the results of the project, some are skeptical of its technical feasibility. Yet, one thing is certain. This is definitely a new direction in the push for AI as well as a path to self-improvement for mankind.
Looking back at the slogan on the company's website, the pioneer of the future, we hope that through Project "Brain", Titan Matrix will be able to create a bright future for mankind.
Lana Cliff has expressed concern for those who suffer from inexplicable brain damage.

Sources said that a large number of homeless people suffering from inexplicable brain damage have appeared recently all over Allivia. They have gathered in the city, are intellectually disabled and do not possess the ability to think independently. Some are even emotionally unstable and wander around damaging public facilities. This has raised concern among welfare organizations and homeless shelters in Allivia.

According to the shelters, these homeless people are aged between 18 and 25, evenly split between men and women and have otherwise normal vitals. After further studies, traces of surgery are found in their brains. They are believed to have received brain surgeries at one point or another. These surgical procedures appear to be a lot more advanced than those carried out in normal hospitals. They also appear to have gone through proper rehabilitation afterwards.
The police said that they are looking into the matter. Due to the limited amount information available, they welcome any leads from the public.

As of the time of this report, presidential candidate Lana Cliff has expressed concern for the situation and will donate part of her campaign fund to help these homeless people find a home and receive proper treatment. She has also urged the police to get to the bottom of the matter and prevent it from happening again.
Shocking! The secrets of Company T

As the largest multinational corporation in Allivia, Company T has always presented a clean image of itself. But recently, has learned from a reliable source that a highly mysterious organization exists within the company. Its goal is to control the fate of humanity!

Because of the powerful influence that this internal organization has in Allivia, we dare not reveal the company's name. According to the sources, this mysterious organization is called "Company T Thirteen" and is the group in control of the company. The organization is also divided into different levels. 6 members are in the upper level in charge of planning, while another 6 are in the lower level responsible for execution. The final member is the mysterious head leading these 12 members. The division of labor is crystal clear. The upper level 6 members formulate plans based on the instructions of the mysterious head. The lower level 6 members correspond to the senior management of Company T, loyally executing all kinds of anti-human orders! Sounds like a movie? Indeed, these names remind us of powerful villains from ancient times. It's hard to believe they actually exist in 21st century Allivia!

According to our analysis, the purpose of their research is to control everyone's thoughts and actions in order to achieve a sinister goal. If their plan succeeds, each person will have a microchip implant in the brain, and their actions will be monitored as well as controlled. Everyone will become a puppet of Company T, and mankind will no longer have any freedom!

segment.source: File NO: Project Brain No.017

Project "Brain" Periodic Report

As part of the preliminary preparation for Project "Brain", we have selected and injected some fertilized eggs into the bodies of a group of female volunteers, hoping to obtain test subjects that would meet the requirements. But among all the pregnant women who gave birth, only Lucrezia Borgia's child Billy Cavendish met the standards of the human brain digitization experiment.

We used the avalanche incident as a cover up to remove Billy from Lucrezia Borgia and later on scanned the data of his brain. But an unknown error occurred during the data extraction, causing an irreversible effect on Billy's brain. Such effect will have a serious impact on the growth of his brain.

The consciousness data sample extracted from Billy has been confirmed to meet the requirements of Project "Brain", which can now enter the next phase. The priority level of Billy himself has been lowered. After he receives a new identity, he will be handed over to presidential candidate Lana Cliff as an orphan and be under surveillance.

Provide new identity Cloud Shawn to Simon Cavendish of the PR department. Assign him to Lana Cliff to carry out new PR operations. To ensure loyalty of Cloud during the operation, the monitoring personnel will be given permission to execute his son Billy anytime.

After obtaining the consciousness data sample of Billy, we began experimenting on the transfer of consciousness. We had one success case in the experiments with animals. But after the experiment ended successfully, the feline animal went missing. The operations department has already looked into the incident.

While attempting to transfer consciousness to a human brain, the experiment failed multiple times because human consciousness is more complicated relative to animals. Planning of the follow-up experiments have been accelerated.

Lucrezia Borgia is suspected to be involved in the recent disappearance of the animal test subject. Assign suitable inspector immediately to inspect Lucrezia Borgia carefully. The consciousness data is of the utmost importance to Titan Matrix.

File NO: Internal Report No.001
File Type: Internal Report
Security Level: Lv4
Last Step
After countless failed preliminary experiments, we finally made a breakthrough with Project "Brain". The project can enter the final execution phase.
The phase will be broken down into three parts:

1. Publicize contents from the experiment about the promotion of brain development. Detect whether someone meets the standards for extraction of human brain consciousness data by implanting a microchip into the brain. The goal is to identify test subjects more perfect than Billy Cavendish.

2. Continue to perfect the technology on extraction of human brain consciousness data in order to minimize side effects on the subjects' bodies. The side effects observed on Billy Cavendish is too great. The consciousness data extraction currently cannot be applied to internal personnel.

3. Attempt to transfer the extracted human brain consciousness to a human body. To minimize the resource depletion of the test subject, the transfer experiment will first be carried out on mammals. After a successful result is obtained, transfer to a human body will begin, with the final goal of making consciousness eternal.

We have waited for too long. We had even questioned whether the ultimate dream was just a dream. But under the leadership of ██████ and through the hard work of everyone, our persistence has finally been rewarded. We are just one step away from eternal life.
